snippet.title: HITMAN World of Assassination - The Wizard (ft. Wiz Khalifa) Elusive Target
snippet.description:
A new challenger steps into the ring.

Your target is the entrepreneur and former boxer, Taylor “The Wizard” Graves. You have been hired to protect Tim Quinn, CEO of Quantum Leap and stop Graves from taking him out.

Available for FREE until July 5th.

https://bit.ly/TheWizardDLC

ABOUT IO INTERACTIVE IO 
Interactive is an independent videogame developer and publisher with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, Barcelona, Istanbul, and Brighton. As the creative force behind some of the most talked-about multiplatform video games in the last two decades, IOI is dedicated to creating unforgettable characters and experiences using their award-winning proprietary Glacier technology. IO Interactive has developed and published a reimagined James Bond origin story with 007 First Light and is currently developing a new IP under the codename Project Fantasy. For more information, visit: https://ioi.dk.

#HITMAN #Agent47 #TheWizard
